This '''male Sith Saber''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] who lived around [[43 ABY]]. In that year, the [[Sith Saber]] served under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Viun Gaalan]] when Gaalan traveled to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to retrieve [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], the sole survivor of a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] that had been sent to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|attack]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. However, on Dathomir, Skywalker, his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]] found the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|attacked]] them. Ben Skywalker rushed the Sith Saber, but abruptly changed directions, causing the [[Gender/Legends|man]] to stumble and drop his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Stadd then fired on the Sith four times, the first bolt he [[Tutaminis|caught]] with his hand, but wasn't able to catch the second one and it struck his knee, then the third his shoulder, and the fourth his throat, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.
